links.explanation: Both reports highlight that permitting patients to self‑certify for medication without checks enables vulnerable individuals with addiction problems to obtain drugs in unsafe quantities. They also note that allowing patients to opt out of informing their GP removes an important safeguard against misuse.

sources.quote: Breach notices and remedial notices are performance related sanctions resulting from breaches of NHS pharmacists' terms of service.
